clips.title: Childhood Friends in One-Sided Love
grammar: 〜ないといけない — must / have to

lines.en: Childhood friends with 20 years of mutual unrequited love.
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.en: Go for broke!
lines.speaker: Haru

lines.en: Why would I want to break, idiot?!
lines.speaker: Kaede

lines.en: The super disappointing boy and...
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.ja: オカンいなくなると俺生きていけないし。
lines.en: If Mom's gone, I can't survive.
lines.speaker: Haru

lines.en: Who're you calling 'Mom'?!
lines.speaker: Kaede

lines.en: ...the motherly girl.
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.en: I just want normal love.
lines.speaker: Kaede

lines.ja: ダメダメでバカな俺じゃない！
lines.en: And not with a useless idiot like me?!
lines.speaker: Haru

lines.ja: ちゃんと素敵な相手とちゃんと恋するから。
lines.en: I'm going to find someone really nice and fall in love properly.
lines.speaker: Kaede

lines.en: Do whatever you want!
lines.speaker: Haru

clips.title: A Rival's Confession
grammar: 〜てどうする — what are you going to do by doing...

lines.en: I've always loved you.
lines.speaker: Iori

lines.en: I like you, too!
lines.speaker: Haru

lines.ja: それ俺に言ってどうすんの？
lines.en: What's the point of telling that to me?
lines.speaker: Iori

lines.ja: 千円が復刻みたいなやつだよ！
lines.en: It's like... declaring a republic of 1,000 yen!
lines.speaker: Haru

lines.en: You mean a declaration of war.
lines.speaker: Iori

clips.title: Confidence to Make Her Happy
grammar: 〜てくれる — to do for someone

lines.ja: 大丈夫だって、俺がいるから。
lines.en: You'll be fine, because I'm here.
lines.speaker: Haru

lines.ja: 閉店の関取みたいなやつだ！
lines.en: Like a closing-time sumo wrestler!
lines.speaker: Haru

lines.en: A bolt from the blue.
lines.speaker: Elderly Woman

lines.ja: 楓を幸せにする自信がある。
lines.en: I have the confidence to make Kaede happy.
lines.speaker: Iori

lines.en: I'll stay by Kaede's side.
lines.speaker: Iori

lines.en: There's no way I can just give up!
lines.speaker: Haru
